title: For EU Markets: Removal of approved couriers for Shipped by Seller (3PL) domestic orders
content: # What is changing? TikTok Shop periodically reviews the couriers approved for the **Shipped by Seller (3PL)** fulfillment method. Effective **October 14, 2026**, the couriers listed below will be removed from the approved courier list for **domestic EU orders**. This change applies to **local-to-local (L2L) sellers only**. | EU (L2L ONLY) | Provider name | Provider ID | | --- | --- | --- | | ES | SEUR | 7038836933132289793 | | ES | Ontime | 7447770919805650695 | | ES | Sending | 7038808610033370882 | | ES | Zeleris | 7203274924226512642 | | ES | Redur | 7563974390129968914 | | ES | Dachser | 7038795162650150658 | | IT | TNT | 7073775627609835266 | | IT | TNT Italy | 7038838469963024129 | | IT | Arco Spedizzione | 7641130961962452756 | | IT | TWS | 7615212966140774151 | | IT | Fercam | 7533260542899652372 | | FR | Geodis | 7359034210140555014 | | FR | Relais Colis | 7470765163365271304 | | FR | Vente-unique Delivery | 7642687585852065556 | | FR | heppner FR | 7643733649539991303 | | DE | GEL | 7533260804896851719 | | DE | TNT | 7073775627609835266 | | DE | Kuehne + Nagel | 7572505951475861256 | # Which markets are affected? This change affects domestic orders in **Spain (ES), Italy (IT), France (FR), and Germany (DE)**. The scope is **L2L only**. # Who is affected? This change affects developers and applications that support sellers using **Shipped by Seller (3PL)** for domestic orders in ES, IT, FR, and DE, where those integrations use or maintain approved courier selections for L2L workflows. # What action is required? 1. **Update your applications.** Use the most current shipping provider IDs returned by the [Get Shipping Providers endpoint](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-shipping-providers-202309). ***This endpoint should be called dynamically as some sellers may be whitelisted and still have access to removed provider ids.*** 2. **Inform your seller base.** Notify sellers of this change and the available options below to help them avoid order sync issues. 3. **Ask sellers to choose one of the following options:** * **Option A — Switch to an approved courier.** Sellers must switch to an approved courier before **October 14, 2026** to avoid order cancellations. See the [approved courier list](https://seller-ie.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=3317258248472321&identity=1). * **Option B — Switch to Shipped via Platform.** TikTok provides shipping labels in Seller Center and updates tracking information automatically. Read the [Shipped via Platform guidance](https://seller-es.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=3148241730815745&role=1&course_type=1&from=search&identity=1&account_ts=1754407463061®ister_libra={). * **Option C — Switch to Fulfilled by TikTok.** TikTok stores, packs, and ships sellers’ orders. 4. **No action is required for existing tracking numbers.** Tracking numbers updated before **October 14, 2026** will continue to be tracked normally after that date.
